newsitem.title: USA: Fiserv in marketing pact with Stephens.
newsitem.headline: Fiserv in marketing pact with Stephens.

text.p: Fiserv Inc said Friday it has formed a strategic marketing alliance with Stephens Inc and has an agreement to merge the clearing brokerage operations of Stephens into the Philadelphia-based BHC Securities business of Fiserv.

Under the agreement, Fiserv will acquire the financial institutions correspondent clearing businesses of Stephens, which includes the discount brokerage services conducted through banks and other correspondents, and Link Investment Services Inc, a brokerage affiliate of Stephens.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

"With this agreement, the BHC Securities business of Fiserv continues to gain strength as a major player in this market," said George Dalton, chairman and chief executive officer of Fiserv, in a news release.

"This is, indeed, a growth business for Fiserv and we plan to make the necessary investments to help keep BHC positioned as a leading independent resource for securities processing and clearing services," he said.
BHC Securities was formed in 1983 and acquired by Fiserv in May of 1997.
Stephens is headquartered in Little Rock, Ark. and has offices in Boston, Atlanta, Tampa, New Orleans, Dallas, Houston and London.

BHC Securities, a subsidiary of Fiserv, provides processing and related services through an on-line, real time computerized order-matching and accounting system that supports all aspects of a retail brokerage operation.
Fiserv provides financial data processing systems and related information management services and products to banks, credit unions, mortgage firms and savings institutions worldwide.
